text:
Kyra (AE): Heads-up: Prospect (Northbridge Health) returned MSA w/ DPA redlines. They want KMS escrow language + a PAdES-certified signature, and procurement pushes Net60 on the PO. Their SecOps blocks outbound signing APIs. Need path to sign + avoid delaying Dedicated POC.

Harper (Legal): Can you paste the escrow/redline line? Short: we can offer an escrow-certificate from our KMS vendor and a tenant-scoped attestation within 7 business days. Actual escrow of live keys requires separate SOW. For signatures, propose: portal-uploaded PAdES-LTV PDF or client-side browser signing if their network blocks outbound egress.

Kyra (AE): Redline: "Vendor shall escrow production keys with a mutually approved third party and provide PAdES-certified signatures with qualified timestamps prior to production onboarding."

Harper (Legal): Counter-proposal text: "Vendor will provide a certificate of escrow arrangement from its KMS vendor and deliver a signed attestation limited to Customer's tenant keys within 10 business days. Escrow of live key material requires a separately executed SOW." Also add portal-signature fallback: "Signed PAdES-LTV PDF uploaded to Vendor secure portal with timestamp shall be treated as a valid signature."

Dmitri (Finance): Net60 raises exposure. For POCs <$30k we default to Net30. If they insist on Net60 require CFO signoff and either a $25k refundable hold or milestone billing (50% upfront). Also require PO on invoice and three-way match details.

Inez (Security): We can produce PAdES-LTV with RFC3161 timestamps and embed OCSP/CRL for long-term validation. Need to confirm TSA meets their "qualified" criteria. Regarding escrow: we will provide the escrow certificate but cannot deposit live private keys without explicit controls in a SOW.

signing-bot: Uploaded redline: https://secure.docs/redwood/northbridge/northbridge_msa_dpa_redline.pdf  checklist: [Escrow certificate draft] [PAdES timestamp check] [Finance Net terms decision] [Signature fallback confirmed]

Kyra (AE): Actions: 1) I'll ask procurement if Net60 is mandatory or negotiable and whether portal-upload/PAdES is acceptable. 2) Harper to drop escrow + portal signature language. 3) Dmitri to confirm finance path if Net60 insisted. 4) Inez to validate TSA. Need to lock this before end of week.

Harper (Legal): Drafting the addendum now; will post link here when ready.

Dmitri (Finance): If estimate stays ~24k => Net30 OK. Escalate to me for Net60.

Kyra (AE): Thanks team 44d
